statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-32778: libexpat before 2.7.5 can dereference a NULL pointer in setContext when parsing is retried after an earlier out-of-memory condition (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-32778). Upstream fixed it in https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/pull/1163 (commit https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/commit/576b61e42feeea704253cb7c7bedb2eeb3754387), first released in expat 2.7.5. Checked the version string compiled into libexpat.so in the libexpat package of every build of expat published in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository, 2.7.3-r0, 2.7.4-r0, 2.7.5-r0, 2.8.1-r0, 2.8.2-r0, 2.8.3-r0, 2.8.3-r1, 2.8.4-r0, 2.8.5-r0, 2.8.5-r1, 2.9.0-r1 and 2.10.0-r1, on x86_64 and aarch64; both architectures agree and each build reports the upstream release in its package version. 2.7.3-r0 and 2.7.4-r0 report expat_2.7.3 and expat_2.7.4, which predate the fix; 2.7.5-r0 reports expat_2.7.5. Every later build is a later upstream release. The range ends at 2.7.5-r0.

CVE-2026-32778: libexpat before 2.7.5 can dereference a NULL pointer in setContext when parsing is retried after an earlier out-of-memory condition (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-32778). Upstream fixed it in https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/pull/1163 (commit https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/commit/576b61e42feeea704253cb7c7bedb2eeb3754387), first released in expat 2.7.5. Debian fixed it in trixie with the expat 2.8.2-1~deb13u1 security update (DSA-6404-1, https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/DSA-6404-1). The first DHI build of that Debian version is the fixed version here: its libexpat1 package reports expat_2.8.2 on amd64 and arm64, and its shipped changelog records the sync to Debian's 2.8.2-1~deb13u1 security upload. The later published builds of Debian's 2.8.3-1~deb13u1 and 2.9.0-1~deb13u1 are newer upstream releases.
